name: source_selection_ranges_and_questionnaire_selection

test_list.description: Cursor offsets inside combining sequences, emoji ZWJ sequences, wide scalars, and out-of-range positions yield exact complete grapheme byte ranges.
Unicode alphanumeric/underscore runs and whitespace runs are selected whole; punctuation selects exactly one grapheme.
Logical line range includes an existing LF or CRLF terminator, handles blank lines and EOF, and ignores visual soft wraps.
SetSelection applies to active notes field, insertion/deletion preserves answer focus semantics and undo restores selected notes.
Selecting all text containing a combining/ZWJ sequence and an attachment chip deletes as one legal range and undo restores complete text, chip and selection.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Canonical Unicode source text indexed by UTF-8 byte offsets.

inputs.name: at
inputs.description: Possibly interior or out-of-range source byte offset.

output_description: Byte range for the grapheme, contiguous word or whitespace run, or logical line at the clamped source position; questionnaire selection is applied through the active Composer editor.
